resources.string: The real Instagram app, mostly just your messages. You get 10 minutes a day of feed, Reels and Explore; after that they send you straight back to your inbox.
Step 1: install the Instagram app and log in. You\'ll chat in the real app; DMs keeps it on Messages.
Step 2: turn on the DMs focus guard. Tap the button below, find DMs (it may be under \"Downloaded apps\" or \"Installed services\") and switch it on.
✅ All set. Open DMs from your home screen to go straight to your messages.\n\nFeed, Reels & Explore today: %1$s left of 10:00.
✅ All set. Open DMs from your home screen to go straight to your messages.\n\nToday\'s 10 minutes of feed, Reels & Explore are used up. They\'re back tomorrow.
⚠️ The focus guard is switched on, but Android hasn\'t started it. Switch DMs off and on again in Accessibility settings. On Xiaomi, also set Autostart ON for DMs (App info › Autostart).
If Android says \"Restricted setting\": tap App info below → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again. Android does this for apps installed outside the Play Store.
10 minutes a day, then back to Messages
Swiping past a reel someone sent you
1 minute of feed time left today
That\'s your 10 minutes for today. Back to Messages 💬
Only the reel you were sent 🙂

• Hide the Instagram icon (put it in a folder) and open DMs instead.
• Reels people send you always open. Swiping on to more uses the 10 minutes; after that you're sent back to the chat.
• Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO: Settings › Apps › Manage apps › DMs: Autostart ON, Battery saver: No restrictions. Otherwise the system may switch the guard off.
• You get 10 minutes a day on the feed, Reels and Explore. Only time on those screens counts; after that they send you back to Messages until tomorrow.
• Settings are also in the long-press menu of the DMs icon.

Keeps Instagram on Messages: when the Home feed, Reels or Explore tab opens, DMs taps Instagram\'s Messages button for you. It only looks at Instagram, only reads which tab is open (never your messages), and nothing leaves your phone.
